topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Friends come and go, but the ones who stick around usually have a good reason. Found out today that one of mine's been spinning tales, weaving a web out of something shiny but not gold. Said they had a fancy job uptown, a corner office with all the trimmings. But the truth? Well, it’s one of those things that don’t need the light to be seen clear. Now, I don’t know what’s worse, finding out the job’s a lie or realizing they thought they could keep me in the dark. Trust ain’t something you get back once it’s lost, not without a whole lot of work. Maybe they had their reasons, but reasons don’t pay the bills. Gonna have a talk, clear the air. See where that leaves us.
